verdict.rationale: Jira is a work-tracking and project-management SaaS, not a coding agent or browser-automation tool. Having an agent navigate an app and capture before-and-after screenshots to verify its own implementation is outside this product category. Nothing in the evidence shows Jira shipping browser navigation or screenshot capture, so the axis does not apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent verify its own implementation by navigating the app and capturing before-and-after screenshots
